_comment: Settings for the work queue. Installed as queue.config.json in the project root. Missing fields get the defaults in scripts/orchestrator/lib/queueConfig.js. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_gates: Shell commands the tracks run before delivery (gates.mjs --quick / --full). Empty lists = no gates.
_migrations: Optional numbered migrations. folder = null turns the whole migration flow off.
architectureRules: Example rule: the UI layer never calls the database directly.
_modules: Areas of the product for the plan register (queue.mjs plan modules).

modules.title: Example
modules.description: Example module, rename or delete it

modules.title: No area yet
modules.description: Projects that do not belong to an area yet

_protectedPaths: Merge guard: paths a track may only change when its task owns them (owned_files/shared_patch); otherwise merge-track stops with exit 4 (--allow-guard overrides). "folder/", "dir/file" or a bare file name (any folder). Leave the field out for the default list in queueConfig.js; [] turns the guard off.
_loadGuard: Load guard: next, start and fill refuse new starts (exit 7, THE MACHINE IS FULL) while free memory is below minFreeMemoryPct percent. null = off. cq limit minFreeMemoryPct <n|off> overrides it for the queue.
_qa: QA evidence: tracks write EVIDENCE <type>[=<ref>] in report.md and receive stores it. autoTypes are closed by cq qa auto --run when autoCommand is green ({refs} = the refs, {id} = the task id; a string or { type: command }). evidenceLabels = labels receive warns for when the line is missing.
_capacity: Weekly quota reset used by queue.mjs capacity. null = default (Tuesday 19:00 local time). resetDay 0-6, 0 = Sunday.
_board: mascot: the speech bubble on the board, "chatty", "events" (only events and clicks) or "off" (no bubbles for anyone). queue-board.mjs --mascot overrides it.
